name: glassteel
lore_descriptor: a crystal alloy, clear as a window and harder than steel
first_pickup_chronicle: Glassteel, forged in a fire with no fuel. It rings when I tap it. Flame and frost seem to bend around it, like they were told not to.
design_notes: Fills pf 70 gap. Anti-elemental — three resistances. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 5).
